changes: No more admin checks or self-elevation: actions that need administrator rights now explain how to run Scy as administrator, and 'Admin' labels show which ones need it
Updates: Scy now updates from GitHub releases, verifies every download's checksum, and can roll back to the previous version from Settings
Your settings and notes now live in %APPDATA%\Scy (moved automatically), with a button in Settings to open the folder
Tweaks: see which tweaks are applied, and Revert restores your exact previous settings
Passwords: new passphrase mode; copied passwords stay out of clipboard history and are cleared after 30 seconds
SSH: protect new keys with a passphrase
Notes: keep multiple notes
Apps: update checks work in any Windows language, the Store search is faster, and installed apps no longer show up twice
Network: IPv6 DNS presets with address checks, and a faster, more accurate speed test
Cleanup now covers every browser profile and reports the space actually freed
Hosts editor keeps your file's formatting and saves a backup before writing
Long tasks (tweaks, uninstalls, file hashing, SFC/DISM, Wi-Fi list) no longer freeze the window
Reworked interface: a cleaner, consistent design across every tab, with side-rail navigation, reorganized Settings, and Settings now opening from a cog in the title bar
Apps: install or uninstall straight from an app's right-click menu
Apps: after scanning your installed apps, the Store marks what you already have and offers Uninstall
Faster tab switching: Apps and System no longer gather data just from opening them; load it on demand with the on-screen buttons
New tweaks: Disable WPBT execution, Disable Windows AI, Prevent device metadata download from the network
A broken tab no longer stops Scy from starting; it's skipped and reported
New: optional debug log for troubleshooting (Settings > General)
New: export and import your apps list to back up or share (Settings > Apps & Groups > My apps)
Faster startup: heavy tab work now loads on first visit (~50% quicker launch)
QR code generator: module styles (rounded, extra round, dots) under Advanced options
Apps: add your own apps to the Store via Settings or right-click a search result
Tools: QR advanced options are collapsible and tidier
Added a changelog (Settings > General > Changelog)
